prompt: Hey, I'm working on an e-commerce page and a few things look off. The hero image looks kinda stretched, some product names are getting cut off, and the customer reviews section — I can only see the first 3 reviews but there should be 5. Can you help me figure out what's going on?

expected_bugs.description: Hero image (1920x600 natural) rendered at 100% width x 500px height with no object-fit — image is vertically squished
Long product names truncated with ellipsis due to white-space: nowrap + overflow: hidden + text-overflow: ellipsis on .product-name with width 270px
expected_bugs.fix: Remove white-space: nowrap or increase width, or use -webkit-line-clamp for multi-line truncation

expected_bugs.description: Reviews container has overflow-x: hidden — reviews beyond visible area are clipped, user can't scroll to see them
expected_bugs.fix: Change overflow-x: hidden to overflow-x: auto on .reviews-scroll

expected_bugs.description: Product images have different natural aspect ratios but are all forced to 200px height with no object-fit
Notification popup has opacity: 0.99 creating an accidental stacking context, and z-index: 50 which is lower than the header (z-index: 100)
expected_bugs.fix: Remove opacity: 0.99 or increase z-index above header

prompt: I built this analytics dashboard and something's wrong with the orders table — it seems like columns are getting cut off on the right side. Also a user reported that the notification panel sometimes goes behind the top bar when they scroll. Can you take a look?

expected_bugs.description: Data table wrapper has overflow: hidden but table has min-width: 900px — columns on the right are clipped
expected_bugs.fix: Change overflow: hidden to overflow-x: auto on .data-table-wrapper

expected_bugs.description: Notification panel has z-index: 30 while topbar has z-index: 40 — panel content scrolls behind the topbar
expected_bugs.fix: Increase notification-panel z-index to >= 40, or restructure layout

expected_bugs.description: Sticky thead inside overflow: hidden container — position: sticky won't work because the scroll container has overflow: hidden
expected_bugs.fix: Change wrapper to overflow-x: auto for sticky to work within the scroll container

expected_bugs.description: Main content area doesn't account for the notification panel width — content extends behind the panel
expected_bugs.fix: Add margin-right: 320px to .main or reduce main content width

prompt: I have this blog post page and there are some layout issues. The code snippets seem to be getting cut off on the right — like you can't see the end of long lines. Also the images in the 'Related Articles' section look weird, some are squished. Oh and on smaller screens the table of contents and share bar probably overlap with the content but I'm not sure.

expected_bugs.description: Code blocks have overflow-x: hidden — long lines are clipped instead of scrollable
expected_bugs.fix: Change overflow-x: hidden to overflow-x: auto on .code-block

expected_bugs.description: Article image has fixed height: 350px with no object-fit — will stretch/squish depending on source aspect ratio
Related article images have different natural aspect ratios but are all forced to height: 140px with no object-fit
Cookie banner has z-index: 5, which is below the nav (z-index: 10) and share bar (no z-index) — may not layer correctly on all browsers
expected_bugs.fix: Increase z-index on cookie banner to be above all content

expected_bugs.description: Table of contents is fixed at right: 40px with width: 200px — on smaller viewports it overlaps the article content since article has max-width: 740px and is centered
expected_bugs.fix: Hide TOC below a breakpoint or make it responsive

expected_bugs.description: Share bar is fixed at left: 40px — on smaller viewports it overlaps with the article content
expected_bugs.fix: Hide share bar below a breakpoint or reposition it
